name: Gleipnir Grimoire
summary: The whole swarm can be reasoned about as one typed living deck, so Tao sees the system instead of juggling its fragments.
hyperstition: The whole swarm can be reasoned about as one typed living deck, so Tao sees the system instead of juggling its fragments.
myth: A living sliver-web binds every strain, land, scar and signal into one shared map without making the map the queen.

engineering.pattern: typed knowledge graph + configuration registry + materialized operational view + static analysis
engineering.origin: knowledge graphs, configuration management, database views and compiler linting; mature
engineering.exemplar: Gen143 PR54 decklist + exact-ID card graph + execution bindings/snapshot/report + CARD-LINT/currentness tools

checks: card governance state is distinct from execution state
decklist and execution snapshot contain the same card IDs
every RUNNING state requires fresh owner evidence and TTL
all Git-backed LINKS resolve to exact card IDs
operator report is a projection, not a truth source

runtime.note: Source engineering maturity is a historical author assertion, not fresh runtime evidence.

art.prompt: Original HFO editorial science-fantasy. Obsidian, restrained crimson light, ivory highlights, etched technical geometry, tactile mineral and archival-paper textures. Vertical 4:5, one clear central silhouette, quiet crop margins. No text, numerals, logos, badges, evidence stamps, franchise characters or recognizable franchise art. Conceptual illustration only. Subject: Gleipnir Grimoire. Show an architectural archive with visible ingress and egress. Express the intended role without depicting deployment, victory or authority.
